breakdown.description: Inviscid (zero viscosity) is incompatible with diffusion flame which relies on viscous/diffusive transport. The simulation must use sutherland transport, not zero viscosity.
breakdown.reason: The user incorrectly requested to set viscosity to zero for a diffusion flame, which is physically inconsistent. The ground truth corrects this by removing the instruction and relying on the Sutherland transport model. The agent failed to fix this error and explicitly repeated the incorrect instruction: "Set the viscosity coefficient to 0.0 everywhere to represent an inviscid flame."
